description: This Java source file contains a set of unit tests for the EncounterService class within the OpenMRS API project. It utilizes JUnit 5 for testing and tests various functionalities like saving, updating, retrieving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting Encounter objects and related entities, ensuring correct behavior of the encounter management logic. The tests include handling of nested observations, encounter types, conditions, diagnoses, and related cascade operations.

classes.name: EncounterServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the behavior of the EncounterService in the OpenMRS API. It contains multiple test methods covering creation, update, retrieval, voiding, unvoiding, and deletion of Encounter objects and associated entities, ensuring the correct cascade and data integrity.
